meta.title: Settings
meta.description: Opening hours, contact details and PetRide settings.

title: Settings
leaveConfirm: You have unsaved changes. If you leave this page, they'll be lost. Leave anyway?

profile.title: Business profile
profile.description: Clients see these details in the PetRide app.
profile.name: Business name
profile.nameHint: The title of your card in the app.
profile.addressHint: The Azerbaijani address is required. If Russian or English is empty, we'll show the Azerbaijani one.
profile.phoneHint: Clients call this number from the app. For example: +994 12 565 66 55
profile.emailHint: For emails and reports from PetRide.

logo.title: Logo
logo.hint: PNG, JPG or WebP up to 2 MB. Square images look best.
logo.typeError: That file type won't work. Pick a PNG, JPG or WebP.
logo.sizeError: That file is too big — pick an image under 2 MB.
logo.readError: Couldn't read that file. Try another image.

map.title: Map pin
map.alt: Your business on the map (sample map)
map.hint: Drivers come to this pin. You'll soon be able to move it here; if it's wrong right now, message the PetRide team.

categories.title: What you offer
categories.description: Pick the app sections you should appear in.

profile.reviewHint: When your name, address or services change, the PetRide team checks them before they update in the app.
profile.reviewBody: The PetRide team is checking the name, address or services you sent on {{date}}. They'll update in the app once checked.
profile.reviewToast: Your new name, address or services will show in the app once the PetRide team has checked them.
profile.saveHint: Phone, email and logo update right away.

errors.name: Add your business name.
errors.email: Check the email address, like info@example.az.

hours.title: Opening hours
hours.unconfirmedBody: These are sample hours. Until you confirm them, the app doesn't show your opening hours to clients.
hours.alwaysOpenOn: The app will say “Open 24/7”. Your weekly schedule is kept — turn 24/7 off and it comes back.

confirm247.title: Are you really open 24/7?
confirm247.body: Clients will see “Open 24/7” in the app and may come at night. Only confirm if someone's there around the clock.

errors.range: Closing time has to be after opening time.
errors.breakOrder: A break has to end after it starts.
errors.breakOutside: Breaks have to be within opening hours.
errors.datePast: That date has passed — pick today or later.
errors.dateDuplicate: That date is already on the list.

exceptions.title: Holidays and special days
exceptions.description: Days you're closed or keep different hours.
exceptions.empty: No special days yet. Add holidays so clients don't turn up when you're closed.
exceptions.noteHint: Shown next to the date in the app.

preview.label: How it'll look in the app
preview.caption: The app updates as soon as you save.
preview.captionUnconfirmed: Shows in the app once you confirm.

hours.saveHint: The app updates as soon as you save.
hours.saveHintConfirm: Saving confirms your hours — then they show in the app.

toast.body: Clients will see them in the PetRide app.

petride.title: PetRide integration

requests.title: Requests
requests.description: How you take appointment requests from the app.
requests.autoConfirmHint: Requests within your hours are confirmed right away. Turn it off to accept each one yourself.
requests.windowHint: If you don't reply in time, the app suggests the client picks another time.

rides.title: PetRide rides
rides.description: A driver brings the pet from home and takes them back.
rides.acceptHint: Clients can book a PetRide driver along with the appointment.
rides.buffer: How early the driver drops the pet off
rides.bufferHint: Time for check-in and for the pet to settle.
rides.offWarningBody: Rides already booked stay as they are. New requests won't be able to add a driver.

courier.title: Courier delivery
courier.description: A PetRide courier takes orders to your clients.
courier.acceptHint: When you mark an order “Ready”, a courier is booked automatically.

connection.title: App connection
connection.note: Requests, rides and orders arrive from the app in this dashboard in real time.

petride.saveHint: Applies to new requests as soon as you save.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: When and where we let you know.

newRequest.title: New request
newRequest.body: When a client asks for an appointment in the app.

rideArriving.title: Ride arriving
rideArriving.body: The driver's bringing a pet and is almost there.

newOrder.title: New order
newOrder.body: When a client places an order in the app.

newReview.title: New review
newReview.body: When a client leaves a review after a visit.

notifications.sound: Play a sound for new requests
notifications.soundHint: You'll hear a short chime while the dashboard is open.

summary.title: Daily summary
summary.description: A short email every morning: what's on today, yesterday's revenue and new reviews.
summary.toggleHint: One email a day at the time you pick.

notifications.demoNote: Demo mode doesn't send emails — your settings are still saved.
notifications.savedToast: Notifications will follow your new settings.

errors.email: Enter a valid email for the summary.

team.title: Team
team.description: Who works in the dashboard and what they can do.
team.caption: Team members

owner.title: Owner
owner.body: Everything: prices, hours, team and security.

manager.title: Manager
manager.body: Appointments, orders, prices, hours and stats. Can't manage the team.

staff.title: Staff
staff.body: Appointments, orders and clients. Can't change prices or settings.

team.aloneBody: Invite your colleagues — together you'll answer requests faster.
team.removeBody: They won't be able to sign in to the dashboard. You can invite them again later.
team.cancelBody: The invite link will stop working.
team.inviteDescription: We'll email them an invite. You can change their role later.
team.name: Name (optional)
team.nameHint: How they'll show up in the list.

errors.email: Check the email address, like name@example.az.
errors.duplicate: That email is already on the team.

language.title: Dashboard language
language.description: Changes right away — you stay on this page.
language.emailDescription: Notification emails and the daily summary come in this language.
language.clientsNote: Messages to clients use each client's app language.

security.passwordDescription: Pick a strong password to keep your account safe.

errors.rules: Use at least 8 characters with a letter and a number.
errors.same: Pick a password that's different from the old one.

security.demoNote: In demo mode the sign-in password stays the same.
security.sessionsDescription: Devices signed in to the dashboard.
security.sessionsNote: See a device you don't know? Sign it out and change your password.
security.confirmBody: They'll need the password to sign in again.
